findings.title: Expandable non-YAML CodeBlocks labelled YAML Configuration
findings.problem: CodeBlockExpandPopup now renders ExpandedYamlShell, which hardcodes the header to 'YAML Configuration'. The previous popup used header ?? title ?? language.toUpperCase() ?? 'Code', so any expandable CodeBlock with a non-YAML language or a title now shows the wrong label.
findings.impact: Latent regression in the shared CodeBlock API. No live caller passes a non-YAML expandable block today (the only expandable caller, WorkflowExecutionConfigYaml, uses language yaml), so the mislabel is not reached on a live path yet.
findings.recommendation: Add an optional label prop to ExpandedYamlShell (default 'YAML Configuration') and have CodeBlockExpandPopup pass title ?? (language ? language.toUpperCase() : 'Code'). Keep the YAML callers' label unchanged and add a CodeBlockExpandPopup test for a non-YAML header.
